title: Super fun class,a
text:
Excellent class. Morgan the chef was awesome. They can work with food allergies. I am a bit of a picky eater but I was able to enjoy what we made.

Totally worth the money and I'd do it again!
author: cruisermeg

title: Book this experience….
text: An amazing value for the money spent.  Another couple cancelled so we were thrilled the class continued and had a private evening.  Guido, the chef and assistant made the evening - almost like we were a guest in the home.  We’ve been in Barcelona for a week - first time we had paella was tonight.    Hard to imagine it would be better elsewhere - especially since we were guided so well by Guido, the chef.
author: BrianLerkins

title: Welcome to Catalonia
text: We don’t typically take classes on our vacations, but this experience looked interesting. Morgan met us at Santa Caterina market and gave us a very thorough tour of the local vendors and their specialities. Then we walked over to the kitchen loft to learn the traditional paella recipes while enjoying tapas treats and drinks. Morgan has a wealth of knowledge to share while we chopped and enjoyed the company of our fellow travelers. It was a perfect introduction to the rich , and wonderful food culture of Barcelona. title: Amazing experience
text: Highly recommend this cooking class Morgan was our Chef, who is Michelin trained and very knowledgeable in the culinary world. She provided us great insight on what we were cooking and the local products we were using. I have a few food allergies and she curated a special menu for us so that I could eat the meal we were preparing. Very professional. Location amazing. Facilities excellent. Highly recommend.
author: Susan_G

title: Best experience for authentic paella and sangria
text: Morgan was amazing. Very welcoming and friendly. Great service and lovely hospitality provided to me in my guest. She gave us thorough explanations about the culture in food in Spain and we had a great time learning from her experiences while living here. I have some very specific food, allergies, and she curated and tailored all the menus specifically so that I would be able to eat all the food we prepared. The level of service was above and beyond what we  expected. The food was great. The  establishment are very well kept and clean. Definitely book this Viator trip excursion.
